title: Chat window
summary: A whole chat window on the host port simai.chat-port 1.0.0: the conversations (archive, paging, search, pinning), the open conversation with its messages, proposals, ratings and task briefs, the field with its files and the questions queued while an answer is awaited, the search within the conversation, whom one talks to, and «Мои файлы». It never talks to a server: the host gives the data and answers each intent, through the port or the settle action.

template.description: Template variant name for SfBaseElement external templates.

capabilities.description: The port capabilities the host offers, space-separated (assistant, people, files, edit, delete, feedback, proposals, conversation-create, conversation-manage, interlocutors, read), and the window extensions (x-archive-view, x-conversations-paging, x-conversations-search, x-conversation-pin, x-early-upload, x-my-files, x-brief, x-conversation-start, x-members, x-reactions, x-reply). What is not declared is not offered, and its intent is answered unavailable without an event. The property also takes an array.

landmark.description: main when the window is the page; section inside a page that has its own main.

heading-level.description: The level of the window's own headings (the conversation, the greeting): 2 inside someone else's page.

embedded.description: Embedded in a host page: the window takes the container's height and draws its own edge.

no-queue.description: Turns the queue off: while an answer is awaited the field sends nothing and says why, as before 1.1.0.

feed-state.description: port data feed_state: loading draws the column anew, revoked clears the feed, the draft and anything unsent; set as a property (feedState, or the port's feed_state)

me.description: port data me {id, name}: who reads

conversations.description: port data conversations [{id, title, type, interlocutor, unread_count, updated_at, archived, pinned}], newest first; pinned is x-conversation-pin's

conversation.description: port data conversation: the open one {id, title, interlocutor, can_send, archived, revoked}, null when none is open

messages.description: port data messages: the open conversation's, oldest first (kind person|assistant, body, html, files, status, stage, wait, sources, verification, notices, proposal, feedback, summary, limit_resets_at, brief, local)

limits.description: port data limits {body_chars, files_per_message, file_bytes, file_types}; with x-conversation-start the window's own group {title_chars, members_max, search_min, search_max, query_chars?}, by default 120, 49, 2, 20, 80 Between people (1.5.0) limits.message_chars, the module's name for it, is read before body_chars; both the field and the editor take the one limit, 4000 when neither is given.

interlocutors.description: port data interlocutors [{id, title, greeting, suggestions, capabilities {attachments, proposals, memory}}]: the first is the usual one

notice.description: port data notice {kind: info|error, text, retry}: a line above the field, an error with «Повторить» when retry is a function

conversation-list.description: the window's data (x-archive-view, x-conversations-paging, x-conversations-search) {archived, has_more, loading, query}: which list is shown, whether it has a next page, whether it loads, what it was searched for

composer-files.description: the window's data (x-early-upload): the field's chips in the port's file form {key, id, name, size, state: uploading|ready|failed, progress, reason}

my-files.description: the window's data (x-my-files) {files [{id, name, size, type, created_at, saved_to_base, download_url}], used_bytes, quota_bytes}; download_url is the host's, never built here

port.const: simai.chat-port 1.0 (ui-source's src/core/contracts/ports/simai.chat-port/1.0.0/port.json); the window's own capabilities x-archive-view, x-conversations-paging, x-conversations-search, x-conversation-pin, x-early-upload, x-my-files, x-brief, x-reactions, x-reply and data conversation_list, composer_files, my_files beside it, not in it

setData.summary: several of the port's data at once, by the port's names or the settings'; unknown keys are ignored (the 0.3 applyData(partial), kept as the method) (action set-data; answers an outcome)

settle.summary: a host without a port answers an intent: result {answer, reason, text, data, current}; refused unknown-request when nothing waits under that id (the 0.3 answer(request_id, result), kept as the method) (action settle; answers an outcome)

startConversation.summary: «Новый разговор» from the page's own button (port conversation.create); answers once the host did (action start-conversation; answers an outcome)

openConversation.summary: open a conversation (port conversation.open) (action open-conversation; answers an outcome)

focusComposer.summary: the field (the page's skip link); from «Мои файлы» it is the way back (action focus-composer; answers an outcome)

openFiles.summary: «Мои файлы» in place of the conversation (x-my-files); refused capability-not-provided without it (action open-files; answers an outcome)

closeFiles.summary: back to the conversation; focus false leaves the focus where it is (action close-files; answers an outcome)

setListFooter.summary: what the page shows under the list of conversations, after «Мои файлы» (Mirai24: the spending); null takes it away (action set-list-footer; answers an outcome)

openFind.summary: Open the search in the conversation, focus in its field; query searches at once (action open-find; answers an outcome).

closeFind.summary: Close the search in the conversation; the focus returns to what opened it (action close-find; answers an outcome).

openPreview.summary: Open the source preview beside the conversation (action open-preview; answers an outcome).

schema.description: {title, kind, preview_url, locator, mime, n?}: preview_url of the page's origin; locator {from, to} characters of the text, or {page} of a PDF.

closePreview.summary: Close the source preview; the focus returns to what opened it (action close-preview; answers an outcome).

openStart.summary: the form of a new conversation or group in place of the conversation (x-conversation-start); kind private, the default, or group; refused capability-not-provided without it (action open-start; answers an outcome)

closeStart.summary: closes the form; focus false leaves the focus where it is, else it returns to the command that opened it (action close-start; answers an outcome)

openMembers.summary: a group's members in place of the conversation (x-members); refused capability-not-provided without it, no-members when the open conversation is no group (action open-members; answers an outcome)

closeMembers.summary: closes the members; focus false leaves the focus where it is, else it returns to the command that opened it (action close-members; answers an outcome)

applyData.summary: Set several of the port's data at once (and the extension data); unknown keys are ignored. Each datum is also a property of its own name. Kept from 0.3; the action set-data is its manifest form.

schema.description: Any of the port data (me, conversations, conversation, messages, history, feed_state, limits, interlocutors, notice) and the extension data (conversation_list, composer_files, my_files).

revoked.description: Access is gone: the component clears the feed, the draft and anything unsent.

accessibility.focus: The parts keep their own keyboard (the list's roving focus, the field's Enter). After a new conversation or another interlocutor the focus goes to the field; when the last awaited answer of the conversation ends it returns there without scrolling. When what held the focus is gone (an archived row), the way back above the field takes it, never the page. A passing line leaves only when no pointer or focus is on it and hands the focus back to the field. The queue's «Изменить» puts the question back in the field and the focus there; «Убрать» moves the focus to the card in its place, else to the field. The search in the conversation takes the focus when opened and gives it back to what opened it when closed.

changes: moved from simai/ui-chat to ui-pro (D31): standard simai.smart-component 1.3.9, the element is made from component.json; words in lang/; dated aliases in aliases.json; nothing imported from ui-chat; the parts are placed by tag

chat-port:<name> and chat-window:<name> {request_id, ...payload} -> sf-chat-window-<verb> {request-id, intent, kind, payload} until 2026-12-01 (event, split aliases); sf-chat-window-answer -> sf-chat-window-settled
the port is handed with connect-port {port} (raise(intent, payload)); a host without one answers with settle (answer(request_id, result) kept)
the port's data are settings (feed-state, conversation-list, composer-files, my-files with their port-named properties kept); applyData kept, set-data its action
a message is drawn by sf-chat-message (renderMessage), the window listens to the new names of sf-chat-composer, sf-chat-interlocutor and sf-chat-message
The first-paint snapshot's sheets.json lists the utility sheets its markup uses (retaken on ui-source 5ba9399); no behaviour changed. Nothing to change for a host.

The queue: a question sent while an answer is awaited waits above the field as a card («Отправлю после ответа», «Изменить», «Убрать») and goes as an ordinary message.send after a successful answer, one at a time; an answer that ended otherwise holds the queue for «Отправить» by hand. Per conversation, on this page only. The setting no-queue turns it off. No new intent and no change for a host.

The search in the open conversation: the actions open-find {query} and close-find {focus}, Ctrl/Cmd+F inside the window, the event toggle {kind: find, open} and the host state data-find-open. It searches the loaded messages only and asks the host nothing.

The source preview (API.md v1.3, proposed): a footnote or a source title with a same-origin preview_url opens the source beside the conversation (a sheet over it on a narrow window), with the passage {from, to} marked; the actions open-preview {source} and close-preview {focus}, the event toggle {kind: preview, open}, the cancelable open {kind: preview} and the host state data-preview-open. Without preview_url nothing changes.

An assistant message's steps and an answer's files (mime, preview_url) are passed to sf-chat-message 1.1.0, and while there are steps the announcer says the step at work. No new intent: the host answers nothing new.

Between people: with the capability people a person's message draws as sf-chat-message's template person (author, avatar, own on the end side, runs of one author within 5 minutes on one day, time, «изменено», files, tombstone). Without it nothing changes.

edit and delete: «Изменить» and «Удалить» on a person's message the host allows (can_edit, can_delete) raise message.edit and message.delete with the revision and a client_key; a conflict shows the current message with «Сообщение уже изменили», «Оставить их» and «Заменить своим»; data.message of an applied answer is merged (a newer revision wins).
read: «Новые» before the first unread message (from the conversation's unread_count) when a conversation opens, and message.read for the last message seen at the bottom, at most once in 2 s.
Between people the field says «Напишите сообщение». No new intent and no new port field.
The source preview marks the passage named by preview_url's #fragment (the element of that id, e.g. <mark id="cite">) when the locator has no {from, to}.

x-conversation-start: the list head offers «Новый диалог» and «Новая группа» (sf-thread-list 1.5.0 create-commands) and the form stands in the conversation's place; intents recipients.search (query, kind recipients) and conversation.start (create, kind private or group), limits.group from the host. After applied the host supplies conversations by set-data, before or after; the window opens data.conversation itself, raising conversation.open when no messages came.
x-members: a read-only «Участники» view for an open group or channel; intent members.list (open, kind members), roles owner, manager, member, observer.

Actions open-start, close-start, open-members, close-members; toggle kinds start and members; host states data-start-open and data-members-open. Without the capabilities nothing changes; simai.chat-port 1.0 is unchanged.
Between people with edit: ArrowUp in the empty field opens the editor on the newest own message the host allows; Escape or a save from there returns to the field.

The editor takes the field's limit: past 80 % the count, past the limit saving is refused with a line and the typed text stays. Between people limits.message_chars is read before body_chars, for the field too.

Between people: a day's divider before the first message of each calendar day with a created_at («Сегодня», «Вчера», a date in the page's language); no created_at, no divider. A divider restarts a run. «Новые» is now role=separator with the class sf-chat-divider--unread added. Needs sf-chat-message 1.3.0.
Without people and edit nothing changes; simai.chat-port 1.0 is unchanged.
The source of the narrow-your-search probe says what the generated file says; no behaviour changed. Nothing to change for a host.

Between people: a message by its author (author.kind or kind assistant): a person a bubble with sf-avatar, an assistant, agent or bot a document with its sign, name and word; one to one no sign or name in the feed.
Between people an assistant's wait neither blocks nor queues the field; Stop is on the message where can_stop allows it.
x-reactions: pills and the picker, message.react. x-reply: quotes, the strip over the field, message.reply {…message.send's payload, reply_to_id}.
Needs sf-chat-message 1.4.0 and sf-chat-composer 1.2.0. Without people, x-reactions and x-reply nothing changes; simai.chat-port 1.0 is unchanged.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-chat-window for a whole chat: conversations, the open conversation and the field, on a host that implements simai.chat-port 1.0.0 (Mirai24's assistant, simai.chat).
do_not: Do not fetch from the element: hand it a port (connect-port) or answer its events with settle
Do not answer an intent both through a port and through settle
Do not decide what a person may do from who wrote a message; give can_edit and can_delete
Do not build a second list of conversations beside it; the window's sf-thread-list is the one
Do not keep a queue of your own for messages sent while an answer is awaited; the window queues and sends them after the answer (no-queue turns it off)
ai_guidance.minimal_example: <sf-chat-window capabilities="assistant feedback proposals conversation-create conversation-manage"></sf-chat-window> with element.connectPort({port: 'simai.chat-port', version: '1.0.0', capabilities: [], raise: (intent, payload) => host.answer(intent, payload)}) and element.setData({me, conversations, conversation: null, messages: []})
owner_commands: node scripts/run-first-paint.mjs gate <free output> <package output> chat-window
